title: Retry on a failed older/newer page drops the send result
trigger: History page fails to load, press Retry while the driver refuses the send

title: Country box sends getCountries on every open, even when the list is loaded
trigger: Open the shipping/poll/card country box with the list already loaded
effect: A redundant getCountries request each open; the box has no loaded/failed gate
fix: Ask only when auth_state.countries is Idle/Failed (Fetch<T> already says which)

title: Linked media timestamp seek is an Option of (chat,message,seconds,Instant deadline) polled from upkeep
trigger: Open a t.me link with a media timestamp; the message loads late or never
effect: Deadline only evaluated when upkeep runs; the slot is session-wide with a bare ChatId, not owned by account/window
fix: A MediaSeek stage owned by the chat window holding a Task with the deadline, dropped with the chat

title: A queued link is taken from its slot before the send; a failed send drops it with no note
trigger: Click a t.me link while the driver send fails (native error) after auth Ready
effect: Nothing happens: no flow, no error note, link is gone
fix: Keep the link until the send returns a RequestId, or show an error note on Err

title: Join on the invite box takes invite_box before the send and ignores the send error
trigger: Press Join while confirm_deep_link_invite fails
effect: The box closes, no join and no error; the preview stays as session flow stage
fix: Close the box only on Ok(Some(request)); show the error otherwise

title: Device link stage is held twice: DeviceLink::Linking(RequestId) in privacy and DeviceLogin::Waiting{request} in the session
trigger: Link a device by QR; the request id is copied into the UI enum and the session's DeviceLogin
effect: No bug today; the UI Linking stage ends only when poll_device_qr takes the session result, so a result the session discards without answering leaves Linking (busy) until an account switch
fix: One owner: keep the Waiting request in DeviceLogin and let the UI read it (or hold only the UI enum and have the session keep an answer slot)

title: Auto-download limit is held twice: in AutoDownloadDraft and in the step slider state, kept in step by on_auto_download_slider
trigger: Open a source box; move a limit slider; open a chat picker and back
effect: No bug today: open seeds the slider from the draft and the slider callback writes the draft back, but close_picker/save_picker rebuild the box from the draft only, so the two copies agree only by the callback path
fix: Derive the slider position from the draft on render; keep one value

title: EventLogPage.poll Option<Task> is a running/stopped flag: the loop ends by itself (page closed, dialog left) and leaves Some(finished task)
trigger: Open Recent Actions (poll Some), close Group Settings: event_log_poll_tick sees event_log_open_chat() None, returns false and the task ends, but page.poll stays Some. Only the window-inactive path writes None, and resume_event_log_poll reads is_none() as 'stopped'. Today every entry into RecentActions calls start_event_log_poll (group_admin_settings.rs set_group_settings_view), which replaces it, so no stuck poll follows
effect: No wrong output today; a path that reaches the page without set_group_settings_view would see a dead poll treated as running
fix: enum PollStage { Stopped, Running(Task<()>) } that the loop's own exit sets to Stopped

title: event_log_ids (Cell<Vec<i64>>) mirrors the ListState item count and must be reset together with it

effect: List rows out of step with the entries (wrong or missing rows) until the next reset
fix: Keep the shown ids inside one owner that wraps the ListState and only changes through sync()

title: Reopening Share Folder while a link delete is still out asks for the list without waiting for the delete, so the deleted link comes back
trigger: In Share Folder press Delete on a link and confirm (LinkOp::Saving(request)), Done/close the box at once (close_folder_share hands the request to closed_asks as LinkChange), reopen Share Folder: open_folder_share -> driver.fetch_folder_share(folder_id), which (connect/folder_links.rs fetch_folder_share) only checks links.is_loading(), not a DeleteChatFolderInviteLink in flight; getChatFolderInviteLinks can be read before the delete lands. refetch_outdated_folder_links only runs when links.is_outdated() (a list that was loading when the delete was sent), and settle_closed_folder_asks LinkChange arm does nothing on success
effect: The deleted invite link is listed again (with copy/edit) until the box is reopened after the delete has landed; deleting it again errors
fix: fetch_folder_share waits for (or is re-sent on the answer of) the in-flight DeleteChatFolderInviteLink of that folder; the LinkChange ask refetches the list on success
